site_name: Office, 277 St Anns Road, Tottenham, London, N15 5RG
description:
We are sending Full Planning Permission Application for five studio flats with mezzanine floors to each studio flat.
 
We are proposing to change the use from existing hostel use at first floor level into five studio flats with mezzanine floors to each studio flat (please see planning proposed floor plan for further details). 
 
The proposed studio flats will be rented to the Local Authority (Council) for 14 to 16 years old teenagers, therefore we do not need to provide parking space.
 
Development of the five studio flats will be constructed with full sound insulation between the flats and between ground floor ceiling and first floor level will be full sound insulation. 
 
Fireproof partition construction between communal corridors will meet current Building Control Regulation requirements. All external studio flat doors will be fireproof with three side smoke seals with an intumescent strip to meet current building control regulation.
 
All communal corridors fire doors with three side smoke seals with an intumescent strip will meet current Building Control Regulation.
